name: routeros-darkmode-extension
description: Chrome extension that applies a dark theme to Mikrotik RouterOS web interface pages.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run clean && vite build && vite build --config vite.background.config.ts
scripts.watch: npm run clean && concurrently -k -n content,background -c blue,green "vite build --watch" "vite build --config vite.background.config.ts --watch"
